{{Quote|Princess Leia, we've fallen into a stingers' nest! There are three Imperial battlewagons in close orbit around the planet|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Antilles]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="radio script">[[Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''Star Wars'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref>|translated=1}}
'''Stingers''' were creatures that lived in nests. During the [[Battle of Toprawa]], the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] starship ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]'' entered the [[Toprawa system/Legends|Toprawa system]] to receive the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] that the Toprawa [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] had captured from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''Tantive''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], saw that Imperial forces had [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the system with a force that included the ''[[Devastator/Legends|Devastator]]'' and other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. He declared that the ship had "fallen into a stingers' nest."<ref name="Black Knight">{{SWRadio|Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns}}''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Stingers were mentioned in "[[Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns]]," the third episode of the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]].<ref name="Black Knight" />
